subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC Airlines, Date: [Date], Departure: [Time]. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The ABC Airlines Team
